meta.title: Breakdown is pre-filled pro rata and editable by the vendor
gaps: Open the cost breakdown prompt during CBD time, verify the auto-filled pro-rata discounts, change a discount and another price, and assert both edits are accepted.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the cost breakdown prompt during CBD time, verify the auto-filled pro-rata discounts, change a discount and another price, and assert both edits are accepted.

steps.note: Create an RFQ event to provide the vendor-side bidding context.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Use an RFQ pricing stage, which is the closest catalog path to vendor cost-breakdown bidding.
Apply the pricing template required before adding line items.
Create multiple line items so the vendor-side breakdown has more than one price to edit.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor whose portal view will be checked.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its pricing round.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the vendor's pricing round, the closest available entry point to CBD.
